entry.title: DBox 0.6.0
entry.summary: MPC OS 3.10.1 support, and one maker name. **Installs on MPC OS 3.10.1.** 3.10.1 only lists plugins from the internal drive's `VST2 Plugins` folder, so after the update the OP1 plugins went missing from External Plugins. `install-all.sh` now picks the right place on its own: `VST2 Plugins` on 3.10.1 (`/nvme` on Gen2, `/media/acvs-content` on Gen1), and the Synths folder on 3.9.x as before. Turn on Menu > Preferences > Enhancements > Enable Enhancements and External Plugin Support, then run: sh i

entry.title: DBox 0.5.0
entry.summary: Gen1 support and working presets. **Gen1 suite.** There's now an `OP1-Suite-0.5.0-mpc-armv7.zip` for the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61, next to the Gen2 (`aarch64`) one. `install-all.sh` stops MPC once, installs all twenty, and starts it again. It refuses to run on the wrong MPC generation. Both suites need MPC OS 3.x. (#4, #3) **Presets save the sound now.** Saving a user `.xpl` preset used to store an empty state, so loading it didn't change anything. The same went for Programs

entry.title: DBox 0.4.1
entry.summary: Repackaged for the Open MPC plugin catalog. The plugin binaries are the same ones from 0.4.0. What changed is the packaging: catalog ids now start with `op1fx-` (for example `op1fx-delay`), the installer matches the current mpc-vst-plugins template, and the repo carries MPC screenshots and a `tested.json`. Tested on an MPC Live III (Gen2), MPC OS 3.9.1. The armv7 zips (Gen1, Force, MPC One) are built but not tested on hardware yet. Download `OP1-Suite-0.4.1-mpc-aarch64.zip` to install all twenty
